## Discovery & Translational Science

**Multivariate blood biomarker panel stratifies Alzheimer's disease resilience and resistance** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.03.26359415)
- An analysis of 1,009 individuals in the Bio-Hermes-001 cohort integrated 19 molecular assays and six clinical risk instruments, identifying distinct resilient (high pathology, preserved cognition) and resistant (high risk, low pathology) subgroups that together comprise 17% of the cohort.
- Resilient individuals exhibited specific neuroinflammatory proteomic profiles, while resistant individuals displayed an APOE-centered genomic signature.
- A four-biomarker plasma panel comprising Aβ40, p-tau217, p-tau181, and NfL accurately reproduced subgroup classifications with 83% accuracy.

**Plasma neuron-derived extracellular vesicles detect Lewy body co-pathology** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.03.26359636)
- Isolated neuron-derived extracellular vesicles (nEVs) from peripheral blood to quantify brain-derived α-synuclein levels in patients with Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease.
- Results demonstrate that nEV-derived α-synuclein crosses the blood-brain barrier into systemic circulation, offering a non-invasive blood biomarker for Lewy body pathology as an alternative to CSF sampling or skin biopsy.

**High-resolution wrist accelerometry dynamic signatures identify isolated REM sleep behavior disorder** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.03.26359506)
- Extracted 876 physiological and motor features from wrist accelerometry across four cohorts (366 subjects, 5,804 nights) to identify isolated REM sleep behavior disorder (iRBD), a key prodromal marker of α-synucleinopathies.
- A LightGBM classifier incorporating NREM-REM sleep dynamics achieved a subject-level area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.955.
- Combining accelerometry dynamics with an RBD screening questionnaire achieved 72% sensitivity with no observed false positives under leave-one-cohort-out validation.

**Liriodendrin targets PFKFB3 to reverse vascular remodeling in pulmonary hypertension** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.30.741507)
- Identified 6-phosphofructo-2-kinase/fructose-2,6-bisphosphatase 3 (PFKFB3) as the direct molecular target of natural compound liriodendrin via drug affinity responsive target stability (DARTS) assays.
- Liriodendrin suppressed PFKFB3-mediated inflammatory phenotypic transition and smooth muscle cell proliferation in both SU5416/hypoxia mouse and monocrotaline rat models of pulmonary hypertension.

**Causal network mapping of sEEG contacts identifies epileptogenic targets in drug-resistant epilepsy** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.05.21.26353792)
- Evaluated a quantitative metric termed "criticality" using causal network mapping and machine learning across 97 patients undergoing stereoelectroencephalography (sEEG) for drug-resistant epilepsy.
- Contacts with high criticality scores strongly aligned with surgically resected brain regions in patients who subsequently achieved seizure freedom.
- The criticality algorithm outperformed neural fragility models by accounting for time-delayed connections and cross-frequency interactions.

**Expanding the molecular glue target space** [Nature Reviews Drug Discovery](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41573-026-00132-3)
- Review highlighting structural design strategies, chemoproteomic screening techniques, and ternary complex dynamics expanding the targetable genome using small-molecule molecular glues.

---

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

**Oral microbiome transplantation restores tolerance in peanut allergy** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/05/fecal-microbiome-transplant-for-peanut-food-allergy/) / [Nature Medicine](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/4255752/)
- Evaluated oral fecal microbiome transplant (FMT) capsules in human patients and mouse models of food allergy.
- Treatment demonstrated improved clinical tolerance to peanut challenge in trial participants.
- Mechanistic profiling revealed that therapeutic response and oral tolerance induction are mediated by specific gut microbiome-derived bile acid metabolites.

**[Biotech]** **Moderna initiates Phase 1 trial of mRNA-based Ebola vaccine** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/05/biotech-news-moderna-launches-early-ebola-mrna-vaccine-trial/)
- Dosed the first participants in an early-stage Phase 1 clinical trial evaluating an investigational mRNA vaccine targeting Ebola virus disease.

**Cell-culture derived H5N6 influenza vaccine demonstrates immunogenicity in Phase 1/2 trial** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42555510/)
- Evaluated a heterologous prime-boost regimen combining an MF59-adjuvanted, cell-culture derived H5N6 avian influenza vaccine in a clinical trial.
- The vaccine regimen met primary safety endpoints and generated robust cross-reactive immunogenic responses against H5 strains.

**Physiology-guided cardioneuroablation demonstrates 94% freedom from recurrent syncope at one year** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.03.26359633)
- Evaluated extracardiac vagal stimulation (ECVS)-guided cardioneuroablation in 95 consecutive patients presenting with vagally mediated syncope (n=78) or functional bradyarrhythmia (n=17).
- Post-ablation ECVS abolished provoked sinus pauses in 100% of patients, reducing residual AV block to 4.2%.
- At one-year follow-up, freedom from recurrent syncope reached 93.8% and freedom from bradyarrhythmia-related events reached 94.1%.

---

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

**Dronabinol significantly reduces nightmare frequency and severity in post-traumatic stress disorder** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04546-9)
- A 10-week randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial evaluated synthetic cannabinoid agonist dronabinol in patients with post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD).
- Dronabinol administration resulted in statistically significant reductions in both nightmare frequency and nightmare intensity compared to placebo.

**BIOFLOW-DAPT trial compares sirolimus vs zotarolimus-eluting stents in high bleeding-risk ACS** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42555546/)
- Randomized clinical trial comparing biodegradable polymer sirolimus-eluting stents to durable polymer zotarolimus-eluting stents in acute coronary syndrome patients at high risk for bleeding.
- Evaluated clinical outcomes following an abbreviated dual antiplatelet therapy (DAPT) regimen.

**ICECAP trial evaluates therapeutic hypothermia duration post-out-of-hospital cardiac arrest** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42554995/)
- The randomized ICECAP trial evaluated varying durations of targeted therapeutic hypothermia to determine optimal cooling duration for neuroprotection following out-of-hospital cardiac arrest.

---

## Regulatory & Approvals

**[Biotech]** **FDA approves Moderna’s mFLUSIVA, the first mRNA seasonal flu vaccine** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/05/fda-approves-moderna-mflusiva-first-mrna-flu-vaccine/)
- The FDA approved Moderna's mFLUSIVA, granting the first regulatory approval for a seasonal influenza vaccine developed using messenger RNA technology.

**[Big Pharma]** **FDA approves Takeda’s Orzeyful (oveporexton) for narcolepsy type 1** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-drug-treat-full-range-narcolepsy-type-1-symptoms) / [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/05/takeda-narcolepsy-drug-fda-approval-orzeyful/)
- Approved Orzeyful (oveporexton) oral tablets for the treatment of narcolepsy type 1 in adults.
- Orzeyful is the first approved medicine to directly target the underlying loss of orexin signaling, providing coverage across the complete symptom spectrum of narcolepsy type 1, including excessive daytime sleepiness and cataplexy.

**FDA proposes Expedited IND Pilot Program to accelerate U.S. early clinical development** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/fda-meetings-conferences-and-workshops/expedited-ind-pilot-program-educational-webinar-stakeholders-08062026) / [FDA Voices](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/fda-voices/america-must-address-early-clinical-development)
- Announced an educational webinar regarding an Expedited Investigational New Drug (IND) pilot program aimed at establishing networks of Qualified Research Institutions (QRIs) to accelerate protocol review and first-in-human trial starts.
- Acting CBER Director Karim Mikhail noted that Phase 1 clinical trial launches currently take up to two years in the U.S. versus nine months in China, driving early-stage biotech capital and trial execution overseas.

**Fresenius Kabi recalls Morphine Sulfate syringes due to Dilaudid packaging mix-up** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/fresenius-kabi-issues-voluntary-nationwide-recall-one-lot-morphine-sulfate-injection-usp-simplistr)
- Issued a voluntary nationwide recall for one lot of Simplist Morphine Sulfate Injection 2 mg/1 mL after discovering that MicroVault outer packaging labeled as Morphine contained prefilled syringes of Dilaudid (hydromorphone HCl) 0.5 mg/0.5 mL.

**Victory Medical Center Pharmacy recalls compounded Glutathione over endotoxin contamination** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/victory-medical-center-pharmacy-issues-voluntary-nationwide-recall-certain-lots-compounded)
- Initiated a voluntary recall of compounded Glutathione 200 mg/mL multi-dose vials to the patient level after internal quality testing revealed elevated bacterial endotoxin levels.

---

## Business & Strategy

**[Big Pharma]** **Eli Lilly Q2 sales surge on tirzepatide as Novo Nordisk CagriSema misses head-to-head trial endpoint** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/lilly-novo-earnings-2q-2026-wegovy-pill-foundayo-obesity/827027/) / [X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2084973514126217335)
- Eli Lilly posted Q2 revenue of $23B (+48% YoY), driven by tirzepatide sales reaching $9.94B for Mounjaro (+91% YoY) and $4.9B for Zepbound (+46% YoY).
- Novo Nordisk stock declined after its combination therapy CagriSema failed to demonstrate superior glycemic control compared to tirzepatide in a head-to-head Phase 3 Type 2 diabetes trial, while quarterly Wegovy oral pill sales missed Wall Street estimates.

**[Biotech]** **Braveheart Bio raises $382.5M in upsized IPO for cardiac myosin inhibitor** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/braveheart-cardiac-drugs-ipo-pricing/826973/)
- Priced an upsized IPO (Nasdaq: BRVE) of 21.2 million shares at $18 per share, raising $382.5M in gross proceeds.
- Capital will fund clinical development of BHB-1893, a cardiac myosin inhibitor in-licensed from Hengrui Pharma to compete against Bristol Myers Squibb's Camzyos in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.

**[Biotech]** **Attovia Therapeutics secures $289M IPO for anti-IL-31 'Attobody' pipeline** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/attovia-biotech-ipo-price-eczema-pruritis-drugs/827061/)
- Completed an upsized IPO (Nasdaq: ATTO) raising $289M at $17 per share, valuing the company at $767M.
- Proceeds will support ongoing Phase 1 evaluation of ATTO-1310 (an anti-IL-31 biparatopic biologic targeting chronic pruritus and eczema) and five preclinical inflammatory and respiratory programs.

**[Biotech]** **Expedition Therapeutics completes $115M Series B for oral DPP1 inhibitor in COPD** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/expedition-therapeutics-series-b-dpp1-copd-general-atlantic/826874/)
- Raised $115M in Series B financing to fund Phase 2 development of EXPD-101 (XH-S004), an oral dipeptidyl peptidase 1 (DPP1) inhibitor licensed from Fosun Pharma for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.

**[Big Pharma]** **Gilead Sciences reports 8% Q2 sales growth behind HIV franchise** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/pfizer-merck-gilead-earnings-2q-2026-analysis/827029/)
- Reported Q2 product sales of $7.6B (+8% YoY), led by $5.7B in combined sales from HIV treatments Biktarvy and Descovy.
- Twice-yearly HIV prevention injection Yeztugo generated $232M in Q2 sales, keeping the drug on track to hit $1B in full-year 2026 revenue.

**[Big Pharma]** **AstraZeneca and Bristol Myers Squibb deny merger discussions** [X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2084976533785952370)
- Senior sources confirmed no discussions or acquisition negotiations exist between AstraZeneca and Bristol Myers Squibb, dispelling market merger rumors.

**[Big Pharma]** **Amgen early-stage trial halted after enrolling 29 patients** [X](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2084997570300948855)
- Industry reports indicate Amgen terminated a clinical trial after enrolling 29 of 200 planned patients, despite company assertions of completed enrollment.

**[Biotech]** **United Therapeutics reports 4% YoY decline in Q2 Tyvaso sales** [X](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2084951292703539641)
- Reported total Q2 net sales of $452.6M for Tyvaso (treprostinil), representing a 4% year-over-year decrease.

---

## Public Health & Policy

**U.S. expert panel re-evaluates national measles elimination status** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/06/measles-elimination-status-2026-paho/)
- Epidemiologists led by Noel T. Brewer are reviewing domestic outbreak data and transmission chains to assess whether the U.S. meets criteria to retain its official PAHO measles elimination status.

**Child fatality in Chinese investigator-led gene-editing trial raises global oversight concerns** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/05/china-clinical-trial-fatality-safety-questions-investigator-led-studies/)
- A second delayed report of a pediatric patient death during an investigator-initiated gene-editing trial in China has renewed international criticism regarding trial transparency, safety reporting, and oversight standards for non-regulatory clinical studies.
